reason: I tried a chat widget on my site before and it gave wrong answers while nobody used it. A free plan might be worth a look, but I am not paying a monthly fee for a chatbot I have already been burned by.
objection: Will it give my customers wrong prices or wrong bookings, and will I be the one who has to clean that up?
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a business like mine, on a real booking calendar, that it answers correctly and that customers actually use it.
